claim_text: The September 13, 2022 superseding indictment in United States v. Farah et al., No. 0:22-cr-00124 (ECF 57), alleges that the eight defendants devised and carried out a $40 million scheme to defraud the federal child nutrition program (para 1) and that, in total, they fraudulently received approximately $40 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds between approximately May 2020 and January 2022 (para 47). Para 1 language is scheme-to-defraud (alleged_loss); para 47 language is received (amount_paid). These are the same Empire-group $40 million figure, not two amounts. This is a CHARGED_ALLEGED Empire/FOF-family figure. It overlaps the Bock $250 million network charging headline (do not add) and must not be added to HSS totals or to the Mohamed family $12 million.

supporting_passages.quote: The defendants devised and carried out a $40 million scheme to defraud the federal child nutrition program, a program designed to provide free meals to children in need.
In total, the defendants fraudulently received approximately $40 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds between approximately May 2020 and January 2022.

amounts.methodology: Indictment para 1: $40 million scheme to defraud. Same figure as para 47 fraudulently received approximately $40 million. Keep as alleged_loss per charging-headline language; para 47 is received/amount_paid wording of the same number.

qualifiers: para 1 scheme language = alleged_loss; para 47 received language = amount_paid of the same $40M
do not add to Bock $250M charging headline
do not add to Mohamed family $12M
do not sum with Empire $28M / ThinkTechAct / Bushra / shell-company receipts
editorial_notes: Bock $250M is a network alleged_loss that already contains Empire. Record $40M with overlap; never add.
